items.markdown: have an average acceptance rate of 0.80 for $N = 2000$ whereas it is equal to 0.27 for $N = 200$, resulting in a Markov chain which still mixes well. Given that the SMC proposal for $N = 2000$ is approximately 10 times more computationally expensive than for $N = 200$, it might seem appropriate to use $N = 200$ and to run more MCMC iterations.
